[[Thera Capens]] had a '''friend''' who owned a [[motor-sled]]. She convinced her friend to assist her and [[Stevan Makintay]] in transporting the stunned body of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]] from her apartment to Makintay's [[Unidentified freighter (Eyrie Base)|ship]].<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
